@graph.ai_informationAboutApplication: Intended uses: Intended for research and educational use, in accordance with Ai2's Responsible Use Guidelines

ai_metric.value: Olmo 3 Instruct 7B scores: MATH 87.3, AIME 2024 44.3, AIME 2025 32.5, IFEval 85.6, MMLU 69.1, GPQA 40.4 (metric not named in card; scores from Evaluation table)

externalRef.comment: Distribution channels: Open weights/checkpoints released on Hugging Face (usable via the transformers library, with revisions loadable via huggingface_hub); code in GitHub repositories

@graph.ai_informationAboutTraining: Pre-trained on the Dolma 3 dataset, then post-trained in three stages: SFT (supervised fine-tuning), DPO (direct preference optimization), and RLVR (reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards), using Dolci datasets.
@graph.comment:
releaseTime: release date not stated in the card; Hugging Face repo creation time used.
acceptable_use_policy: Licensed under Apache 2.0; intended for research and educational use in accordance with Ai2's Responsible Use Guidelines (https://allenai.org/responsible-use)
access_conditions: false
additional_assets: Code, checkpoints and training details are released (logs coming soon). Repositories: Open-Instruct (DPO and RLVR) at https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct; OLMo-Core (pre-training and SFT) at https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core; OLMo-Eval (evaluation) at https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-Eval. Checkpoints are accessible via the HuggingFace `revision` argument (naming `step_XXXX`). Datasets include Dolci-Instruct-SFT-7B, Dolci-Instruct-DPO-7B and Dolci-Instruct-RL-7B on Hugging Face.
integration_means: Use with the HuggingFace transformers library (version 4.57.0 or higher) via AutoModelForCausalLM and AutoTokenizer; optional 8-bit quantization with bitsandbytes; ChatML-style chat template with <|im_start|>/<|im_end|> tags and a default system message.
base_model_relation: quantized

@graph.name: Pre-trained on Dolma 3; post-trained on Dolci datasets, including Dolci-Think-SFT-7B, Dolci-Instruct-SFT-7B (SFT), Dolci-Think-DPO-7B, Dolci-Instruct-DPO-7B (DPO), Dolci-Think-RL-7B, Dolci-Instruct-RL-7B (RLVR)
Training data of unsloth/Olmo-3-7B-Instruct-GGUF (as described in the card)
@graph.comment:
data_scope: Pre-trained on the Dolma 3 dataset and post-trained on the Dolci datasets; SFT/DPO data consist of math, code, chat, and general knowledge queries; RLVR data consist of math, code, instruction-following, and general chat queries. Language: English.
knowledge_cutoff: Dec. 2024
